examples.text: Tom tomó un curso de control de la ira.
examples.en: Tom took a class to learn how to manage his anger.

examples.text: La ira es difícil de controlar.
Tom no podía contener su ira.
examples.en: Tom couldn't hold back his anger.

examples.text: Sus insultos constantes encendieron su ira.
examples.en: His constant insults aroused her anger.
